$comment: The house style every generated asset shares. generate.mjs puts `global` into every prompt and passes `anchors` (plus the type's own anchors) as reference images, so a new batch of any type matches what's already in the app.
global: Hand-painted fantasy game art in the style of a premium digital card game: rich but restrained painterly rendering, crisp readable silhouettes, warm antique gold metal with soft specular highlights, deep jewel-tone accents (emerald, ruby, sapphire, amethyst), aged parchment and dark leather as secondary materials. One soft warm key light from the upper left, a faint cool rim light, gentle ambient occlusion. Cohesive, slightly desaturated palette that sits on a dark green-black table. No text, letters, numbers, runes that read as text, signatures, logos or watermarks.
